t: Site Lillak Safety Trainers in grey provide essential foot protection and comfort for demanding work environments. These durable work trainers feature a composite toe cap and penetration-resistant midsole, ensuring robust safety without metal components. Ideal for electricians or those working around sensitive equipment, the anti-static sole and fuel oil resistant outsole offer reliable performance. A padded tongue and collar, combined with a PU comfort footbed, deliver all-day wearability, making them suitable for various trade professionals requiring S1 FO PS SR rated footwear.
b: Safety Rating: S1 FO PS SR
Not Tested for Sole Heat Resistance
